body:
Scope: independent M1 milestone Code Review of the complete staged engineering contribution against origin/main e8616763 and the current approved Test/Workflow Design and amended Delivery plan. M1 is consumer/portable-resource/package alignment; M2's bounded test audit remains pending and its selected test modules are unchanged. This judgment is not final whole-change review or Verify.

Actual diff assessment: eleven selected specialist entrypoints use explicit adopted Test-criteria precedence and conditional quality loading; eight have additional maintenance resources triggered by test changes or maintenance impact. Shared application sources and all nineteen local copies preserve the approved derivation chain, independent oracle, meaningful diagnostic contribution and safe maintenance rules. They give customer project policy authority, carry no internal TEST/RC/WF identifiers or contributor paths, and do not impose universal loading, new records, runtime permission or a second assessment owner. The five governing references identify the Test owner internally; RC retains judgment/applicability/closeout policy and specialists assess actual evidence. The original specialist methods and historical format resources retain their qualified responsibilities.

TG-01 semantic evidence was independently compared with the public guidance: same-partition duplication needs distinct contribution; useful diagnostic-only localization requires an explained material benefit and renamed repeated assertions are insufficient; helper/public tests preserve different dispatch/side-effect protection; missing authority for an unlabeled regression preserves reproduction and routes to Design; snapshots require contract-grounded examination; generated inputs retain invariant/domain/counterexample/environment basis. Missing discovery cannot count as cleanup, slow historical tests cannot retire compatibility, and flaky sole protection requires owned investigation/quarantine limits. All three combined hazards preserve required protection without manufacturing an approval. These are manual guidance assessments, not executable semantic scoring or test-defect claims.

TG-02 and generated scope: shared parity validator accepts only selected consumers and rejects unknown consumers, missing canonical/local resources and drifted bytes. Focused regressions exercise those failure paths and actual canonical resource selection. Existing package-shape expectations were changed only for allocated resources; historical-size extraction isolates new conditional guidance rather than claiming token savings. Current candidate metadata is generated through existing machinery, file count rises by the nineteen intended resources, and only current release-index/pin values change. Historical metadata, builders, commands and schemas are unchanged. The evidence's exact unchanged-consumer inventory reasonably retains historical boundary formats, domain methods, templates and existing RC resources; no competing new policy is copied into them.

Checklist: (1) approved requirement/non-goal alignment pass; (2) direct resource regressions plus named semantic scenarios pass; (3) boundary/diagnostic/legacy/flaky/randomized/discovery edge cases pass; (4) unknown/missing/drift error paths fail closed; (5) Test-versus-specialist/RC/Workflow/storage architecture pass; (6) historical procedures and installed customer compatibility pass; (7) public privacy and permission limits pass; (8) canonical/mirror/archive currency pass on supplied current proof; (9) unrelated changes absent and M2 scope unmodified; (10) validation evidence sufficient for M1, with no future audit or final readiness claim.

Actual proof inspected in m1-validation: python scripts/test-skill-validator.py (373 passed; initial three focused tests first failed without support); python scripts/validate-skills.py (20 skills); python scripts/build-skills.py --check and python scripts/test-build-skills.py (8 passed); current v0.5.1 archive build/validation for all three adapters; python scripts/test-adapter-distribution.py (158 passed, 557.070s); npm test --prefix packages/rigorloop (654 total, 652 passed, 2 existing skips, zero failures); model/readability/portable-text checks and git diff --cached --check. I independently checked all 11/8 local copies, new resource privacy strings, actual staged diff and whitespace. Intentional negative-fixture diagnostics in the adapter log do not contradict its passing result. No hosted-CI or measurement claim is made.

No material finding or required correction emerged. M1 can return to route with this exact scoped assessment. The next implementation allocation is M2; its real audit, any test changes, post-change full-module proof and independent review remain required. After both milestones and corrections, fresh final whole-change Code Review and distinct Verify remain mandatory. Recording this judgment changes no engineering subject or routing state and cannot substitute for those later assessments.
independence_basis: Separate delegated agent /root/independent_proposal_review inspected M1 without authoring or editing engineering subjects, tests or generated packages. codex-author implemented the contribution and produced proof. This reviewer previously performed independent upstream assessments only, and here independently inspected the actual diff, current authority and completed evidence rather than approving its own work.
